# Publication-state schema-1 fixture

This fixture was generated by the schema-1 implementation at source commit `ebd68ede96d00a765c028dbc7bff33d06d6283ec`, using its ordinary open, prepare, accept, and observation-recording APIs. It is an offline synthetic fixture for testing the explicit additive upgrade to publication-state schema 2. Tests must copy the database into a private temporary directory before opening it; the checked-in database is immutable input.

The fixture contains two accepted positions (the sequence-1 floor), the corresponding accepted history and cached sequence-2 observation, plus the packed synthetic payload used for the sequence-2 successor. The companion rows file records the exact baseline raw rows; expected values are fixed fixture data, not generated by current serializers.
